name: pdfunsign
title: PDFUnsign - Digital Signature Stripper & PDF Unlocker
description: Client-side privacy-first tool to remove digital signatures (PAdES, CAdES, DocMDP), reset AcroForm permission locks, and strip PDF/A read-only flags from PDF documents.

privacy.description: Zero byte upload guarantee. Processing executes entirely inside local sandboxed browser memory or runtime.

tools.name: unlock_pdf
tools.description: Strips all electronic signatures, form locks, and PDF/A restrictions from a PDF document while strictly preserving 100% native vector graphics, selectable text, and embedded fonts without rasterization.

file.description: The PDF document file (binary or base64) to unlock.

language.description: Language used for filename suffix generation (_unlocked or _deverrouille).

signatures_removed.description: Count of /Sig dictionaries, widgets, and signature stamps stripped.

pdfa_cleared.description: Whether PDF/A read-only restrictions and XMP metadata were neutralized.
